title: Switch the alarm with hysteresis
statement: In the NORMAL mode the thermostat shall turn the alarm on when the current temperature is below the lower alarm temperature or above the upper alarm temperature, and turn it off when the current temperature is at least 0.5 °F inside both; within the 0.5 °F margin inside either limit it shall leave the alarm as it is.
rationale: The margin gives the alarm hysteresis, so it does not switch on and off while the current temperature sits at a limit.
